Package com.eco.bio7.spatial

package com.eco.bio7.spatial
  • Class
    Description
    Clipping
    Clipping of the volume and the iso surface in the 3D view (to make the interior visible): A clipping box: the parts outside of the box are removed (relative positions 0 - 1 in the extent of the displayed data). A free cutting plane (azimuth, elevation and offset).
    Clipping.Mask
    The removed voxels (immutable).
    Clipping.MeasureToolListener
    The listener of the measurement tools: the mouse events with the window position (pixels of the OpenGL surface, y from the top) and the view ray through the data (relative positions, start and end, or null outside).
    Clipping.Region
    The region of the clipping (the kept side of the box and the plane and the kept voxels of the mask) for relative positions (0 - 1, y = 0 is the first row like in ImageJ).
    HtmlSimulation
    Exports an interactive simulation to an HTML page (a single file without dependencies, WebGL for 3D): Play/Pause, Step, Reset, the speed and controls for the settings (sliders, number fields, text fields, check boxes, choices and buttons) with a 2D grid view (e.g., a cellular automaton), a 3D view (e.g., agents of a swarm model) or a dynamic 3D surface and an optional chart of values over time.
    HtmlSimulation.View
    The view of the simulation.
    IsoSurface
    Creates and renders an iso surface of an ImageJ stack.
    Measurement3d
    Measurements of the iso surface and the volume in the 3D view.
    Plot3D
    A simple API to create 3D plots in the 3D view (the space view) without OpenGL code: the data of one or more plot layers (scatter, line, filled line, surface, wireframe, bars, contour, pie and the charts line graph, box plot, violin plot, histogram, area, radar, rose and treemap, see PlotCharts) with a title, axis titles, log axes, number formats, a legend and a color bar.
    Plot3D.Bars
    Bars (boxes) from the floor (or 0) to the values.
    Plot3D.Contour
    The contour lines of a grid (at their heights or on the floor).
    Plot3D.FilledLine
    A line filled down to the floor (a ribbon).
    Plot3D.Layer<T extends Plot3D.Layer<T>>
    A layer of a plot with the common settings: a label (for the legend), a color, a color map and the transparency.
    Plot3D.Line
    A line through the points.
    Plot3D.Pie
    A 3D pie chart (without axes, the labels in the legend and the percentages at the slices).
    Plot3D.Scatter
    A scatter plot: spheres at the points.
    Plot3D.Surface
    A surface of a grid (smooth shading, optional with the lines of the grid).
    Plot3D.Wireframe
    A wireframe of a grid.
    PlotLegend
    A legend of the 3D view (see SpatialUtil.setLegend and SpatialUtil.setColorBar): the labels with the colors of categories (e.g., the groups of a scatter plot) or a color bar of a continuous color ramp with the numbers of the values (e.g., the heights of a surface).
    PlotRecorder
    Records a plot of the plot API (see Plot3D) frame by frame, e.g., a plot which is updated in each step of a simulation (see Plot3D.update), and exports the recording to an HTML page with WebGL: the plot with the axes, the title and the legends of each frame, Play/Pause, a timeline, the speed and a loop (the view can be rotated and zoomed while the recording plays) or for Blender as an animation (see exportBlender).
    PlotTable
    The data of the active sheet of the Bio7 table for plots (see Plot3D): the columns as numbers or texts and a dialog to select the columns of the roles of a plot (e.g., X, Y, Z and an optional group).
    PlotTable.Options
    The settings of the plot of the dialog: the title, the axis titles and the logarithmic axes (null for a plot without axes, e.g., a pie chart), the color map and the export action.
    PlotTable.Selection
    The selected columns of the roles of a plot.
    SimulationRecorder
    Records a simulation written in Java (e.g., a Bio7 model) step by step and exports it to an HTML page which plays the recording: Play/Pause, Step, Reset, the speed, a timeline to jump to a step, a loop and the chart (see HtmlSimulation for the views).
    SimulationRecorder.Frame
    The data of a step: the grid, the agents, the points, the lines, the surface and the chart values.
    SpatialCamera
    This class offers methods to adjust a custom camera and methods to get camera coordinates (walk-through camera).
    SpatialEvents
    This class offers static methods to detect custom mouse and key events in the Spatial panel of Bio7.
    SpatialLoader
    This is a utility class for Jogl (OpenGL) to load and create models and textures.
    SpatialMath
    This class offers some utility math methods.
    SpatialPicking
    Picks the object under the mouse in the 3D view (the selection mode of OpenGL): the objects are drawn between startPicking and endPicking with a name (glPushName / glPopName), getSelection returns the name of the nearest object at the mouse position.
    SpatialUtil
    A class which offers some custom methods for the Spatial view.
    ValueSelection
    The values of a stack which are displayed as a volume or an iso surface: all values (the default), a range of values (e.g., the threshold of the image in ImageJ: only the particles) or a list of values (the labels of a segmentation).
    VolumeRenderer
    Renders an ImageJ stack as a volume with a 3D texture.
